summary: BBB Foods Inc. (Tiendas 3B) filed a Form 6-K furnished as an ordinary quarterly earnings release for 3Q26 ended September 30, 2026, not a special-situation event. Reported figures are in nominal Mexican pesos under IFRS: total revenue Ps. 28,445 million, up 40.3% year over year; same-store sales up 20.5%; reported EBITDA Ps. 1,327 million versus negative Ps. 404 million, or Ps. 1,877 million excluding Ps. 550 million non-cash share-based payment expense. The company opened 141 net new stores, reaching 3,765, and four distribution centers, reaching 25. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics disclosed; risk-arb angle minimal beyond ordinary operating momentum.
